name: rasuvaeff/yii3-ab-testing

summary: Assignment, targeting, the event v2 contract, attribution rules and the PSR-3 sinks.

name: rasuvaeff/yii3-ab-testing-db

name: rasuvaeff/yii3-ab-testing-web
title: Web
summary: Anonymous subject id middleware, signed-cookie sticky store and signed receipts for SPA flows.
